rca of the issue: BUG: /api/agency/financial-view 500. RCA: When an agency roster had bookings but a booking's `pricing` field was None (or `payment_schedules` doc absent), line 252 called `sched.get(...)` on a None sched or `b.get('pricing', {})` returned None (dict default only kicks in if key missing, not if value is None). Fix: wrapped with `if sched else 0` and `(b.get('pricing') or {})`. Reproduced by GET /api/agency/financial-view as agency@booktalent.com. Post-fix confirmed 200 with populated artists+bookings.
